Probable causes, depending on what you're seeing:

In the meantime, here's a slug helper you can drop into your project. It fixes the common causes of bad URLs:

```python
# yourapp/utils.py
from django.utils.text import slugify

SYMBOLS = {"&": " and ", "+": " plus ", "#": " sharp ", "@": " at ", "%": " percent "}

def make_slug(text, max_length=50, fallback="item"):
    text = str(text)
    for sym, word in SYMBOLS.items():
        text = text.replace(sym, word)
    slug = slugify(text, allow_unicode=True)   # keeps non-Latin scripts instead of deleting them
    slug = slug[:max_length].rstrip("-")       # fits SlugField's default max_length of 50
    return slug or fallback                    # never an empty slug
```

Then use `make_slug(title)` wherever you currently call `slugify(title)`, and set `SlugField(allow_unicode=True)` on the model. Slugs already saved in your database won't change until you regenerate them.
